GP.name: global pooling
GP.definition: Mean pooling over all 196 Stage-3 tokens.

FC.name: fixed-center support
FC.definition: Four fixed central interior tokens and twelve context tokens; no footprint is used when constructing support.

FI.name: footprint-informed support
FI.definition: Four highest-coverage interior tokens and twelve nearest zero-coverage context tokens. Context tokens are ranked by the minimum Euclidean distance from the token center to a footprint pixel.

recipes.R2_focal: Focal modulation gamma=2 for both heads; damaged-class binary weight=1.5.
recipes.R3_focal: Focal modulation gamma=2 for both heads; damaged-class binary weight=1.5.

training.selection_and_inference: Only binary logits are used for checkpoint selection and reported inference metrics.

primary_evaluation.design: 3 recipes x 3 support rules x 3 Turkey leave-one-city-out folds x 3 seeds
primary_evaluation.bootstrap: Paired percentile bootstrap stratified by Turkey city, with building as the resampling unit and 2000 replicates.

robustness_protocols.P1: Footprint-support perturbation: image fixed; perturb the footprint and then construct FI support.
robustness_protocols.P2: Candidate-localization perturbation: co-translate image and footprint; FC remains centered and FI moves with the building.
